text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Today! Just for today, please, somehow~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want in on the fun too! I wanna be all 
smiles too, damn it!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowah~, what's with this leg...!? Did you 
get stung by a bee or something, Mirako!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“With an unbelievable surge of momentum, 
it was Hishi Miracle who claimed a 
decisive victory.”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-haha! The one favored by the heavens 
today was Mirako! Splendid, simply 
splendid!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mirako-senpai. As for 
me... I guess I fell just a bit short.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, thank you, No Reason-chan, 
Dantsu-chan. Guess luck was on my side 
today.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, luck is part of one's 
ability! Tonight, sing and dance to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm, even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"No, I do not know why, but... Just being 
able to run in this Tenno Sho (Spring)..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I simply cannot contain my immense joy. 
Where do these feelings sweeping through 
my heart come from...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Though I may wish it Never shall it be 
adorned My family crest

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Crossing the river of destiny, treading 
upon verdant grass.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I am well pleased. My 
long-cherished wish has come true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed No Reason was finally able to 
lay some past regret to rest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come, let the three of us greet the common 
folk!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, No Reason! Hishi Miracle! 
Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Show us another great race next time!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye! Leave it to me! Next up is finally 
the grandest battle of this spring. Which 
is to say—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Next time won't be as easy as today. A 
lineup of prominent warlords will be 
waiting!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Forget victory; even a decent run won't 
come easy. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why should the three of us flinch!? Our 
opponents are Umamusume born under the 
very same sky!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Shall we not show them?! The Underdog 
Alliance's grand, once-in-a-lifetime 
performance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans went wild over No Reason's 
theatrical speech. However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, medium distance does seem pretty 
tough, though...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To recapture that day's brilliance once 
more…… I'd love to do something about it, 
but……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Their expressions look grim. Even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Not a chance! If you wish for it strongly 
enough, how could anything be impossible?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, everyone, stay tuned and look 
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The countdown to the spring decisive 
battle has begun. At the Takarazuka Kinen, 
the Gekokujo Alliance will challenge the 
strongest force.
